participants: 港市工匠及有条件的外来教官

desc.zh: 选择王廷常备、各道分担或限额旧军。通过逐月真实状态检查连续观察六个月；坏月立刻清除计时。持续受阻12个月提示，36个月提供退出。无军队可用有岗官署继续有限边警。
desc.en: Choose court supply, provincial shares or capped legacy forces. Monthly real-state checks must pass continuously for six months; a failed month clears the timer. Show a blocked notice after 12 months and offer exit at 36. Without an army, a staffed office can sustain limited border service.

title.en: Who Will Sustain the New Army Office

desc.zh: 首轮通过后连续复核九个月；每个好月实际付款，任何坏月清除九个月计时。和平看训练、轮值与采购，战时先保供并可缩限；内政不因属邦化中断。
desc.en: After the first review, check nine continuous months. Each passing month requires actual payment; any failed month clears the timer. In peace review training, rotations and procurement; in war prioritize supply and allow narrowing. Subject status does not interrupt domestic work.

title.en: The Guards Missing from the Roll

desc.zh: 军门有兵额，却没有列明军粮、军械和轮值由谁持续负担。若没有现役军队，本线改核官署边警与旧军额，不要求扩军。
desc.en: The army office has headcounts but no durable account of food, arms or rotations. Without an active army, this line audits office-based border service and legacy quotas without requiring expansion.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_kor_military_audit }

label.zh: 王廷常备：统一调度
label.en: Court supply: central command

options.effect: { ywc_kor_choose_court_supply = yes if = { limit = { var:ywc_kor_supply_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1001 } }  else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1000 } } }

cost_note.zh: 一次核额费为开启时年总收入÷52，最低100；军队日常费用由游戏军费预算承担。
cost_note.en: One-time audit costs opening annual gross income / 52, minimum 100; regular army expenses remain in the game budget.

consequence_note.zh: 换得中央点验权；须维持职业军制、中档以上军饷与合格军营。固定开支最高。
consequence_note.en: Gains central inspection; requires professional army law, medium or higher wages and qualifying barracks. Highest recurring cost.

label.zh: 各道分担：保留报额权
label.en: Provincial shares: retain local returns

options.effect: { ywc_kor_choose_provincial_supply = yes if = { limit = { var:ywc_kor_supply_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1001 } }  else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1000 } } }

cost_note.zh: 一次核额费为开启时年总收入÷52，最低100；军队日常费用由游戏军费预算承担。
cost_note.en: One-time audit costs opening annual gross income / 52, minimum 100; regular army expenses remain in the game budget.

consequence_note.zh: 中央月额较低，换取各道持续报账与核销权；军营和军饷条件仍真实核验。
consequence_note.en: Lower central allotment in exchange for provincial returns and audit rights; barrack and wage conditions still apply.

label.zh: 限额旧军：降低目标
label.en: Capped legacy forces: lower the target

options.effect: { ywc_kor_choose_limited_legacy = yes if = { limit = { var:ywc_kor_supply_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1001 } }  else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1000 } } }

cost_note.zh: 一次核额费为开启时年总收入÷52，最低100；不另设月度军粮税。
cost_note.en: One-time audit costs opening annual gross income / 52, minimum 100; no extra monthly military-supply tax is added.

consequence_note.zh: 不强迫扩军或改法；有军队时核验军营，无军队时走有岗且无短缺的官署边警通路。
consequence_note.en: No forced expansion or law change; check barracks if an army exists, or use a staffed, supplied office for border service if it does not.

label.zh: 暂缓核额或结束本次登记
label.en: Defer the audit or end this registration

options.effect: { if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_kor_audit_paid } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1000 } } else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_arc_abandoned value = 1 } ywc_kor_close_as_breach = yes } }

cost_note.zh: 暂缓不再扣费；结束时保留已付审计费。
cost_note.en: Deferral charges nothing further; ending retains any audit fee already paid.

consequence_note.zh: 资金恢复后可重试；结束会记录受挫并释放本国活动名额。
consequence_note.en: Retry when funds recover; ending records a setback and releases this country slot.

purpose.zh: 让三种军制都承担代价，并留下后续会读取的不同权责。
purpose.en: Give each military policy a cost and distinct obligations for later reviews.

desc.zh: 核定州的军营必须实际有岗、军用品无短缺，国家预算也需能维持现有军费。这里不额外扣一笔虚构的月度军粮费。
desc.en: The audited state's barracks must be staffed and free of military-goods shortages, and the state budget must sustain its existing military spending. This review adds no invented monthly ration debit.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_supply_route }

label.zh: 维持核定月额并逐月实付
label.en: Keep the allotment and pay monthly

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_supply_account_accepted value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1002 } }

cost_note.zh: 无额外月扣；军饷和供给支出按游戏真实军费/市场系统结算。
cost_note.en: No extra monthly debit; wages and supplies resolve through the game's actual military budget and market.

consequence_note.zh: 只有真实预算、法律、军饷、就业与商品条件连续合格的月份才计入观察。
consequence_note.en: Only months with valid real budget, law, wages, staffing and goods conditions count toward review.

label.zh: 缩小驻防与轮值范围
label.en: Narrow garrison and rotation scope

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_scope_narrowed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1002 } }

cost_note.zh: 无新一次性费；已付军费不返还。
cost_note.en: No new one-time fee; paid costs are not refunded.

consequence_note.zh: 后续按较小目标核验，不能把缩限当成满编或供给达标。
consequence_note.en: Later reviews use a lower target; narrowing does not count as full staffing or supply.

purpose.zh: 把持续费用与真实就业、商品短缺、金库状态绑在一起。
purpose.en: Tie recurring costs to real employment, goods shortages and treasury state.

title.en: The Quotas Sent by the Provinces

desc.zh: 王廷常备要求统一报表；各道分担以核销权换取较低中央月额；旧军限额不扩张，也不承诺统一新编制。
desc.en: Court supply requires a central ledger; provincial shares trade audit rights for lower central payments; capped legacy forces do not expand or promise a uniform establishment.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_supply_route has_variable = ywc_kor_ready_supply_months }

label.zh: 王廷统一编册和点验
label.en: Centralize muster and inspection

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_reporting_mode value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_court_inspection_right value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1003 } }

cost_note.zh: 检查常备军实际预算。
cost_note.en: Keep the higher court-supply allotment.

consequence_note.zh: 地方核销空间缩小；职业军法和军营供给仍由真实状态决定。
consequence_note.en: Local audit discretion narrows; law and barrack supply still depend on real state.

label.zh: 各道定额报送并保留核销
label.en: Require provincial returns and keep local audit

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_reporting_mode value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_provincial_report_right value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1003 } }

cost_note.zh: 由各道方案读取实际预算能力。
cost_note.en: Continue the lower provincial allotment.

consequence_note.zh: 换得地方核销权；报表或供给断裂会阻止后续确立。
consequence_note.en: Retains local audit rights; missing returns or supply failures block establishment.

label.zh: 旧额封顶，不开新军额
label.en: Cap old quotas and authorize no new levies

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_reporting_mode value = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_legacy_ceiling value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1003 } }

cost_note.zh: 保留最低月额，既有欠款照付。
cost_note.en: Keep the lowest allotment; existing arrears remain due.

consequence_note.zh: 减少各道扩军负担，后续目标同步降低。
consequence_note.en: Reduces provincial expansion burdens and lowers later targets.

purpose.zh: 让中央指挥、地方核销与旧军上限进入后续结果条件。
purpose.en: Carry central command, local audit and legacy caps into later outcome checks.

title.en: A Scholar's Note in the Budget

desc.zh: 士林指出军费挤压官学和地方赈务。公开账目增加监督，密议保留调度却损害信任；缩减轮值可缓解预算但降低训练目标。
desc.en: The literati note that military costs compete with schools and relief. Public accounts add oversight; private review preserves discretion at a cost to trust; fewer rotations ease the budget but lower training goals.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_reporting_mode }

label.zh: 公开各道月账
label.en: Publish monthly returns

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_audit_public value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1004 } }

cost_note.zh: 不另收费；公开不退已付款。
cost_note.en: No new fee; publication refunds nothing.

consequence_note.zh: 士林取得查账凭据，军门需解释月额；公开不会改善军营就业或消除短缺。
consequence_note.en: The literati gain audit records and the army office must explain allotments; publication does not staff barracks or remove shortages.

label.zh: 由王廷密议，不公开明细
label.en: Keep the review private at court

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_audit_private value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_court_trust_debt value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1004 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增款项；承担透明度与信任成本。
cost_note.en: No added payment; accept a transparency and trust cost.

consequence_note.zh: 王廷保留机动，士林不获账簿；地方权责仍遵循已选路线。
consequence_note.en: The court keeps discretion and the literati do not receive the ledger; provincial rights still follow the selected route.

label.zh: 缩减训练与轮值目标
label.en: Reduce training and rotation targets

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_scope_narrowed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1004 } }

cost_note.zh: 无新费用，后续按较小目标核验。
cost_note.en: No new cost; later checks use a smaller target.

consequence_note.zh: 减少挤占学务预算，但降低训练量；不能将旧军限额算作常备达标。
consequence_note.en: Eases pressure on schools but reduces training; capped legacy forces do not count as established court supply.

purpose.zh: 把财政监督与调度权的冲突落实为可读取的承诺。
purpose.en: Record the conflict between fiscal oversight and command discretion as later-read commitments.

desc.zh: 本地译学可帮助核对合同，但不会带来科技。外来教官只可作为真实外交接触的后续议题，事件不凭空创造雇佣关系。
desc.en: Local translation work can help review contracts but grants no technology. A foreign instructor is only a follow-up where real diplomatic contact permits; the event does not invent employment.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_audit_public }

label.zh: 资助本地译学与工匠清册
label.en: Fund local interpreters and workshop rolls

options.effect: { ywc_kor_start_translation_contract_once = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_kor_translation_contract_started } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_local_translation_funded value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1005 } } }

cost_note.zh: 仅选后才签约；最多12期，合计不超过开启时一周收入。
cost_note.en: Only this choice starts the contract; at most 12 installments totaling no more than one captured week of income.

consequence_note.zh: 每期真实扣款；资金不足月份暂停，累计已付不清零，合同完成后不再收费。
consequence_note.en: Each installment is a real debit; underfunded months pause, paid totals never reset, and completed contracts stop charging.

options.trigger: { net_fixed_income >= 0 gold_reserves >= { value = var:ywc_kor_weekly_cost multiply = 0.0833333333 } ywc_kor_v03_has_translation_employer = yes }

label.zh: 登记有条件的外聘询价
label.en: Record a conditional foreign hiring inquiry

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_foreign_offer_pending value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1005 } }

cost_note.zh: 暂不扣款，待真实对象、关系和报价确认。
cost_note.en: No debit until a real counterpart, relations and quote are confirmed.

consequence_note.zh: 对象缺席或拒绝时回到本地路线；转为属邦只调整对外谈价，不中断内政。
consequence_note.en: A missing or refusing counterpart returns to the local route; subject status changes foreign negotiations only and does not stop domestic work.

label.zh: 沿用旧作坊并缩小装备目标
label.en: Keep old workshops and narrow equipment goals

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_procurement_narrowed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1005 } }

cost_note.zh: 不增加一次性费用，接受较低装备目标。
cost_note.en: No one-time fee; accept a lower equipment target.

consequence_note.zh: 不假设有进口伙伴或军工厂；真实商品短缺仍阻止供给核验。
consequence_note.en: Assumes neither an importer nor an arms factory; real goods shortages still block supply review.

purpose.zh: 连接港市工匠和外来知识，同时守住不免费送科技的边界。
purpose.en: Connect port workshops and outside knowledge without granting free technology.

title.zh: 旧军户想要一份新差事
title.en: A New Posting for Old Service Households

desc.zh: 军制变化影响实际服务家庭时，可支付限期转职名册与补助，也可保留有限边警轮值。无法确认相关人口时只核对退役名册，不虚构就业转移。
desc.en: When military changes affect real service households, the court can fund a time-limited transition register and stipend or retain limited border rotations. If no households can be confirmed, audit discharge rolls rather than inventing job transfers.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_audit_public }

label.zh: 支付转职名册与期限补助
label.en: Pay for transition rolls and a temporary stipend

options.effect: { ywc_kor_start_veteran_contract_once = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_kor_veteran_contract_started } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_transition_obligation value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_intro_complete value = 1 } } }

cost_note.zh: 自愿转职补助最多12期，合计一周收入；无条件时可选另两路。
cost_note.en: Optional transition support is capped at 12 installments totaling one week of income; choose either other route if unaffordable.

consequence_note.zh: 已付累计不会因恢复或重审清零；退出只停止尚未支付的部分。
consequence_note.en: Paid totals survive recovery and renewed review; exit stops only unpaid installments.

options.trigger: { army_size > 0 net_fixed_income >= 0 gold_reserves >= { value = var:ywc_kor_weekly_cost multiply = 0.0833333333 } ywc_kor_v03_has_staffed_supplied_barracks = yes }

label.zh: 保留旧军户的部分边警轮值
label.en: Keep some legacy border rotations

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_border_rotation_kept value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_scope_narrowed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_intro_complete value = 1 } }

cost_note.zh: 减少补助支出，仍需支付较小月额。
cost_note.en: Avoid stipend costs while keeping a smaller monthly allotment.

consequence_note.zh: 保留传统服务关系，降低训练目标；断供时仍可退出。
consequence_note.en: Preserves service ties while lowering training goals; exit remains available if supply fails.

label.zh: 暂不新增补助义务
label.en: Decline a new stipend obligation

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_transition_refused value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_intro_complete value = 1 } }

cost_note.zh: 不增加费用，旧账照付。
cost_note.en: No added cost; existing obligations remain due.

consequence_note.zh: 退役家庭没有本线补助，但后续仍可重谈；不会抹去实际退役。
consequence_note.en: Discharged households receive no stipend from this line, but later renegotiation remains possible; actual discharge is untouched.

purpose.zh: 明确军制变化由谁承担，并把家庭补助作为真实一次性扣款。
purpose.en: Make the distributional cost explicit and debit the household stipend from treasury.

desc.zh: 只有连续六个月保持真实执行条件后，才可进入九个月续审。任何坏月立即清除计时。12个月持续受阻时提示，36个月提供退出；常规军费仍按游戏本体结算。
desc.en: Begin the nine-month renewal only after six continuous months of real readiness. Any failed month clears the timer immediately. Show a blocked prompt after 12 continuous months and offer exit at 36; regular army spending remains in the base game.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_intro_complete OR has_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_12_notice OR has_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_36_notice }
events.immediate: { ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_v03_kor_v03_kor_military_accounts_last_event value = 7 } if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_review_event_prompted value = 1 } } if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_12_notice } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_blocked_12_prompted value = 1 } } if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_36_notice } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_blocked_36_prompted value = 1 } } }

label.zh: 确认连续六个月点验，进入九个月续审
label.en: Confirm six continuous months and start the renewal

options.effect: { if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_review_complete value = 1 } add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_v03_kor_service_settlement } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete } } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_waiting_for_readiness value = 1 } } }

cost_note.zh: 不收第二次核额费；正常军费按游戏本体结算。
cost_note.en: No second audit fee; regular army spending stays in the base game.

consequence_note.zh: 只有六个月计时完成且当前条件仍好才开启续审；提前改法不替代六个月。
consequence_note.en: Opens renewal only when the six-month timer completed and current conditions still pass; early law changes do not replace the period.

label.zh: 缩限或等待条件恢复
label.en: Narrow the plan or wait for recovery

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_scope_narrowed value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_kor_observation_timer remove_variable = ywc_kor_observation_started remove_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete remove_variable = ywc_kor_review_event_prompted remove_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_timer_started remove_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_12_due remove_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_36_due remove_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_12_notice remove_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_36_notice remove_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_12_prompted remove_variable = ywc_kor_blocked_36_prompted }

cost_note.zh: 已付账不退；未通过真实条件的月份不收费也不计时。
cost_note.en: Paid installments are not refunded; failed months are neither charged nor counted.

consequence_note.zh: 保留现有军队与法律；坏月清零后按缩限月额，重新连续观察六个月。
consequence_note.en: Keep the current army and laws; after a failed month, restart six continuous months at the narrowed installment.

label.zh: 撤回未付新承诺
label.en: Withdraw unpaid new commitments

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_arc_abandoned value = 1 } ywc_kor_close_as_breach = yes }

cost_note.zh: 停止未付部分；保留已付款项和已登记补助。
cost_note.en: Stop unpaid portions; retain paid costs and recorded stipends.

consequence_note.zh: 受挫改道，不解散军队、不改法律，仍可接续地方财政与退役后续。
consequence_note.en: Closes as a setback without disbanding armies or changing laws; provincial finance and veteran follow-ups remain available.

purpose.zh: 检查完整六个月连续执行，失败时重置计时而不伪造改革成功。
purpose.en: Require six continuous months of execution and reset after failure rather than faking reform success.

title.en: Military Goods on the Busan Invoice

desc.zh: 续审期检查港市工匠或内地作坊的真实报价。此处不会造库存、建工厂或开贸易路线；外部伙伴缺席时内部审计继续。
desc.en: During renewal, review actual quotes from port merchants or inland workshops. This event creates no stockpiles, factories or trade routes; domestic review continues if no foreign partner is available.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_kor_service_settlement }

label.zh: 支付货单核价并维持月额
label.en: Pay for invoice review and keep monthly supply

options.effect: { ywc_kor_pay_invoice_once = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_kor_invoice_review_paid } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_procurement_booked value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1008 } } }

cost_note.zh: 只有选择真实核价服务才一次性支付一周收入；不生成军用品。
cost_note.en: Only this paid quotation-review choice debits one captured week; it creates no military goods.

consequence_note.zh: 登记已付款核价，不会授予装备；商品短缺仍阻止通过。
consequence_note.en: Records a paid quotation review without granting equipment; shortages still block certification.

label.zh: 按现有作坊能力缩小采购
label.en: Narrow procurement to current workshops

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_procurement_narrowed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_procurement_booked value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1008 } }

cost_note.zh: 不增一次性费用，目标降低。
cost_note.en: No added one-time cost; lower the target.

consequence_note.zh: 真实市场和建筑决定产能；供给不够时仍须缩限或退出。
consequence_note.en: Market and buildings determine capacity; insufficient supply still requires narrowing or exit.

label.zh: 登记待核实的外部报价
label.en: Record a request for a verifiable foreign quote

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_foreign_offer_pending value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_procurement_booked value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1008 } }

cost_note.zh: 不扣款也不建交易，须伙伴同意并由玩家另行建立贸易行动。
cost_note.en: No debit or trade route; a partner must agree and the player must establish trade separately.

consequence_note.zh: 韩国成为属邦只影响未授权对外谈价，不中断内部续审。
consequence_note.en: Korea becoming a subject affects unauthorized foreign talks only; internal review continues.

purpose.zh: 让采购受真实市场与对方同意限制。
purpose.en: Keep procurement subject to real markets and counterpart consent.

desc.zh: 和平时复核训练、轮值与采购；真实战争时转为战时报账，优先供给并允许缩限。战争不自动失败；属邦变化不打断内部日志。
desc.en: In peace, review training, rotations and procurement. During war, use the wartime ledger, prioritize supply and allow narrowing. War is not automatic failure; subject changes do not interrupt the domestic journal.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_kor_service_settlement OR = { has_variable = ywc_kor_procurement_booked has_variable = ywc_kor_procurement_narrowed has_variable = ywc_kor_foreign_offer_pending } OR = { has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_service_12_notice has_variable = ywc_kor_service_36_notice is_at_war = yes in_default = yes net_fixed_income < 0 } }
events.immediate: { ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_v03_kor_v03_kor_military_accounts_last_event value = 9 } if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_service_event_prompted value = 1 } } }

label.zh: 按和平账册复核训练和轮值
label.en: Review training and rotations in the peacetime ledger

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_service_review_complete value = 1 } } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1009 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增军队、训练或免费收入。
cost_note.en: Creates no troops, training or free income.

consequence_note.zh: 九个月连续合格后才标记通过；和平本身不是通过条件。
consequence_note.en: Marks completion only after nine continuous months; peace itself is not a pass.

options.trigger: { NOT = { is_at_war = yes } has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes }

label.zh: 战时保供并暂停非必要轮训
label.en: Prioritize supply and pause nonessential rotations

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_scope_narrowed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_wartime_deferral value = 1 } if = { limit = { ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_service_review_complete value = 1 } } set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_pending_event value = 1009 } }

cost_note.zh: 无额外月扣；战时暂停部分仍由真实军费系统处理。
cost_note.en: No added monthly debit; real army costs remain in the base-game system.

consequence_note.zh: 战时继续读短缺与预算；恢复后九个月计时重新开始。
consequence_note.en: Continue reading shortages and budget during war; renewal timing restarts after recovery.

options.trigger: { is_at_war = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes }

label.zh: 缩限承诺并重新开始连续续审
label.en: Narrow the commitment and restart continuous review

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_scope_narrowed value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_timer remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_observation_started remove_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_review_complete remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_event_prompted remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_blocked_timer_started remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_blocked_12_due remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_blocked_36_due remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_12_notice remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_36_notice remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_12_prompted remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_36_prompted }

cost_note.zh: 已付款不返还；缩限后按较低真实月额重新观察九个月。
cost_note.en: Past payments are not refunded; after narrowing, restart nine months at the lower actual installment.

consequence_note.zh: 保留军队、法律和旧合同；恢复计时须连续满足预算、工资、就业与供给条件。
consequence_note.en: Keep the army, laws and existing contracts; the timer restarts only while budget, wages, staffing and supply remain valid.

label.zh: 承认账款无法维持并退出
label.en: Acknowledge the unfunded plan and exit

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_arc_abandoned value = 1 } ywc_kor_close_as_breach = yes }

cost_note.zh: 停止未付款项，已付款和服务义务保留。
cost_note.en: Stop unpaid plans while retaining paid costs and service obligations.

consequence_note.zh: 不强制解散军队，保留限额旧军与地方重谈入口。
consequence_note.en: Does not disband the army; capped legacy forces and local renegotiation remain available.

purpose.zh: 区分和平维持与战争保供，并读取真实连续九个月条件。
purpose.en: Distinguish peacetime readiness from wartime supply and require nine continuous months.

title.en: The State Ledger Beyond the Army Office

desc.zh: 结算读取当前军法、军营就业、商品短缺、军饷、财政、地方报表和九个月连续审查。常备固定成本最高；各道方案以报账权换中央支出；限额旧军保留较小边警目标。
desc.en: Settlement reads current law, barrack employment, goods shortages, wages, budget, provincial reports and the nine-month continuous review. Court supply has the highest fixed cost; provincial supply exchanges returns for lower central spending; capped legacy forces keep a smaller border goal.

events.trigger: { c:KOR ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes ywc_kor_v03_unsettled = yes has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_kor_service_settlement }

label.zh: 确立王廷常备供给
label.en: Establish court supply

options.effect: { if = { limit = { var:ywc_kor_supply_route = 1 has_variable = ywc_kor_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_service_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes } ywc_kor_close_as_court_supply = yes } }

cost_note.zh: 无结局奖金；固定费用仍由实际财政承担。
cost_note.en: No completion bonus; recurring costs remain in treasury.

consequence_note.zh: 不点击改法或增军；确认既有职业军法、合格军营和持续供给。
consequence_note.en: Does not enact law or add troops; confirms existing law, barracks and continued supply.

options.trigger: { var:ywc_kor_supply_route = 1 has_variable = ywc_kor_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_service_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes }

label.zh: 确立各道分担
label.en: Establish provincial shares

options.effect: { if = { limit = { var:ywc_kor_supply_route = 2 has_variable = ywc_kor_provincial_report_right has_variable = ywc_kor_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_service_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes } ywc_kor_close_as_provincial_supply = yes } }

cost_note.zh: 无结局奖金；地方月账与报送义务保留。
cost_note.en: No completion bonus; local allotments and returns remain due.

consequence_note.zh: 失去地方报账权或真实供给失格时不能确立。
consequence_note.en: Cannot establish if local returns or real supply eligibility fail.

options.trigger: { var:ywc_kor_supply_route = 2 has_variable = ywc_kor_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_service_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_provincial_report_right }

label.zh: 以限额旧军和边警收束
label.en: Close with capped legacy forces and border service

options.effect: { if = { limit = { var:ywc_kor_supply_route = 3 has_variable = ywc_kor_legacy_ceiling has_variable = ywc_kor_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_service_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes } ywc_kor_close_as_limited_legacy = yes } }

cost_note.zh: 保持最低月额；不返还已付款。
cost_note.en: Keep the lowest monthly allotment; paid costs are not refunded.

consequence_note.zh: 无军队者可凭有岗无短缺官署续做有限边警；不改军法或领土。
consequence_note.en: A country without an army can continue limited border service through a staffed, shortage-free office; no army law or territory changes.

options.trigger: { var:ywc_kor_supply_route = 3 has_variable = ywc_kor_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_service_review_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_six_months_complete has_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes has_variable = ywc_kor_legacy_ceiling }

label.zh: 缩限并重新连续观察九个月
label.en: Narrow and restart nine continuous months

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_scope_narrowed value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_timer remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_observation_started remove_variable = ywc_kor_nine_months_complete remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_review_complete remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_event_prompted remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_blocked_timer_started remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_blocked_12_due remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_blocked_36_due remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_12_notice remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_36_notice remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_12_prompted remove_variable = ywc_kor_service_36_prompted }

cost_note.zh: 不重复支付核价费；只重新观察，已付合同累计和已签义务保留。
cost_note.en: Do not repeat the quotation fee; restart review while retaining paid contract totals and obligations.

consequence_note.zh: 当前条件未达标或复核尚未完成时可重开观察；缩限只降低合同承诺，不改法律或军队。
consequence_note.en: Restart review when current conditions fail or review is incomplete; narrowing reduces commitments without changing laws or armies.

options.trigger: { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_kor_service_review_complete } NOT = { ywc_kor_v03_route_execution_ready = yes } } }

label.zh: 兑现失败时撤回未付承诺
label.en: Withdraw unpaid commitments after failure

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_kor_arc_abandoned value = 1 } ywc_kor_close_as_breach = yes }

cost_note.zh: 停止未付部分，已付和已签义务保留。
cost_note.en: Stop unpaid portions while retaining paid costs and signed obligations.

consequence_note.zh: 失败改道仍接地方财政、官学、工匠和退役后续，不抹去军队。
consequence_note.en: Failure can continue into local finance, schools, workshops and veteran follow-ups without erasing the army.

purpose.zh: 形成可持续常备、地方分担或限额旧军三种不同结局。
purpose.en: Resolve into distinct outcomes for sustainable court supply, provincial shares or capped legacy forces.
